College of Engineering & Information Technology
The College of Engineering & Information Technology empowers students to become innovative problem-solvers and technology-driven professionals. The college is dedicated to producing graduates who are industry-ready, ethical, and capable of creating sustainable solutions that advance society in the digital age.

College of Health Sciences Program
The College of Health Sciences is committed to excellence in education, research, and service in the fields of healthcare and behavioral sciences. It offers the Bachelor of Science in Nursing, designed to develop highly skilled and compassionate nursing professionals, and the Bachelor of Science in Psychology, which prepares students for meaningful roles in mental health, research, and human development. Guided by a strong foundation of scientific knowledge, ethical practice, and social responsibility, the College of Health Sciences equips graduates to respond to the growing demands of healthcare and to contribute significantly to the well-being of individuals and communities.
